19241: The main heroine and number one ranked second year student until Kazuya's interference during a tournament at the start of the story causes her to be demoted to rank two.
19242: The main protagonist and a Limiter who enrolls at West Genetics. His sister, Kazuha Aoi, sacrificed her life to defeat a powerful Nova who invaded Japan in the past and after empathizing with Satellizer, whom he believes resembles his sister, he decides to become her limiter.
39010: She was enrolled into West Genetics as a second grade student. She is simple, honest, and has a righteous character. She wants Kazuya Aoi as her 'soul-mate' (Limiter) because her 'Tears of Kunlun' (Stigmas) reacted when he activates his freezing abilities.
39011: A 3rd year student of the academy. She enjoys watching TV dramas and drinking beer, given that the legal age to drink in germany is 16. Her best friend is Marine, who died a year ago in a fight against a Type-S Nova. She is currently rank No.7 in the third year's Carnival.
39012: A second-year Pandora from the UK known as the Angel of Confinement (束縛の天使, Sokubaku no Tenshi). Originally the 2nd-ranked second-year Pandora, she became 1st-ranked after seizing the advantage of Kazuya's interference to defeat Satellizer.
39013: A 3rd year at the East Genetics Academy and referred to as currently the most powerful Pandora in the series since her sync ratio with her stigmas are the closest to Kazuha Aoi's compared to the other top Pandoras.
39014: A third year student of the Military Academy West Japan Genetics. She is ranked No.2 in the Third Year Carnival. Chiffon Fairchild knows that she is the mastermind behind causing problems to Satellizer. Her Limiter is Andre.
39015: A third year student of the Military Academy West Japan Genetics. She is ranked No.4 in the Third Year's carnival. Her limiter is Morrison. The fourth-ranked strongest third-year student from Switzerland known as the Slashing Trickster, she is also derogatorily known as Mad Dog.
39017: Creo Brand is a third-year student at West Genetics. She is currently ranked 5th among all West Genetics third-year students.
39019: A third year student and the current rank no.1 Pandora of the West Genetics Academy. She is also the student council president, who escorted Kazuya on the day he transfers to the academy.
39143: The Limiter of Genessa Roland. He is kind of Genessa Roland's weak spot as she sometimes behaves different in front of him when alone.
39144: A third grade student of the Military Academy West Japan Genetics. She is the one behind pulling strings between the third grades and Rana (at first meeting) against Satellizer. She is currently rank No.6 in the Third Year Carnival.
39145: She was a participant in the 8th Nova Clash(War) with Yumi Kim and is the Head doctor of West Genetics Academy. She fights with two daggers as her Nova Weapon. She is often seen with Yumi and is good friends with her.
39500: Audrey Duval is a second-year Pandora student at West Genetics. She is currently ranked 3rd among all West Genetics second-year students and she is French.
39501: A first year student. She is in the same class with Arthur and Kazuya. A cheerful and easy-go-lucky type of character.
39503: A veteran of the 8th Nova Clash, she fought alongside Elize Schmitz and the late Kazuha Aoi as part of the elite Numbers unit. As of the current time, she teaches at West Genetics. She holds the rank of Captain in the Chevalier.
39509: A third year student of the Military Academy West Japan Genetics. She is currently rank No.3 in the third grade Carnival and also the student council vice-president. Her limiter is Abel. She always sticks together with Chiffon Fairchild for some reason.
39510: A Third year student of the Military Academy West Japan Genetics. The first third year student to 'teach' Satellizer to 'respect' seniors - which the fact, she herself is jealous and envious of Satellizer.
39511: Aika is a Japanese Pandora and the 4th strongest of all second- year Pandoras in West Genetics. Her Volt Weapon is a chained flail that she can separate in two pieces.
39512: Trish McKenzie is a second-year Pandora student at West Genetics. She is currently ranked 5th among all West Genetics second-year students. Her Volt Weapon, Arondight (アロンダイト, Arondaito), are a pair of broadswords.
39671: The deceased elder sister of Kazuya Aoi, cousin of Ouka Honda and granddaughter of Gengo Aoi. She sacrificed herself in the 8th Nova War to save her companions.
40404: The elder sister of Satellizer el Bridget. She never treated Satellizer as an outsider even though they were born of different mother. Unlike her mother, she was the one protecting Satellizer from being bullied by her younger brother, Louis.
40574: The wife of Howard el Bridget. She despises Satellizer and her mother since she knows the truth of her husband's affair.
40575: Satellizer's mother. The mistress of Howard el Bridget. She was moved in to the house of Bridget under Howard's will due to the reason that she is suffering from an illness. She was the one who sowed the seed of 'never give up' into Satellizer's mentality.
42067: The youngest sibling of the el Bridget family and Satellizer's younger half-brother who used to sexually abuse her as a child. He appears to have a cheerful and caring personality, but hides a dark and sadistic side shown only around Satellizer and Holly. (Source : Wikipedia)
49993: Ingrid's late friend. A second-year Pandora, she died fighting off a Nova to allow first-year students under her command to retreat. Her death was the cause of Ingrid's obsession with rules and hierarchy. Albert was her limiter.
49995: Milena Marius is a 4th year student Pandora at East Genetics. She is a good friend of 3rd year East Genetics Pandora student Cassie Lockheart.
49997: Sister Margaret is the Headmistress of West Genetics.
82187: He is a second-year student at East Genetics. He is the Limiter of Cassie Lockheart.
82193: Su-Na Lee is the strongest active duty Pandora of the Chevalier. She is a Lieutenant of the Chevalier and the appointed leader of the new Anti-Nova strikeforce: Team 13. She is shown to be the personal body guard of Aoi Gengo.
